days.label: Tuesday, Sep 22

picks.name: Braves ML
picks.note: Shut out at home. The bats never showed up - a read failure, not a bad beat.

picks.name: Diamondbacks ML
picks.note: Clean read. Arizona handled a last-place team exactly like a -186 favorite should.

picks.name: Cubs ML
picks.note: Blew up in extras. Second blowout loss of the day against a heavy price.

picks.name: Mariners ML
picks.note: Another shutout loss. Two of the four losses were 0-run games.

picks.name: Mystics
picks.note: Won easily but earned +0.51u on 8u risked - that is the math on huge chalk.

picks.name: Valkyries
picks.note: The expensive one. A -1011 lost in overtime and took 7u with it - more than six times what both WNBA wins paid combined.

days.brief: Split the day 4-4 and still lost 14.44u. The three MLB losses were two shutouts and a blowout - read failures the gate has to catch earlier. The WNBA lesson was pure math: massive minus prices risk a lot to win pennies, and one overtime loss at -1011 cost more than six times what both WNBA wins paid. Chalk sizing rules tightened from this day.

days.label: Wednesday, Sep 23

picks.name: Diamondbacks ML
picks.note: Cashed, but the thesis said the Rockies rookie would get hit and the win actually came from unearned runs and the bullpen. Right side, wrong mechanism.

picks.name: Wings -10.5
picks.note: Won by 12 and covered by a point and a half. The form read on Dallas's turnaround season held.

days.brief: Perfect day, 2-0, +7.88u. Honest note even in a sweep: the ARI win came through a different door than the thesis predicted (unearned runs, not the rookie getting hit), so the system now requires a direct confirmation path when a pick leans on one pitcher imploding. Wins get audited too, not just losses.

days.label: Thursday, Sep 24

picks.name: Yankees ML
picks.note: Won, but the line moved against us before first pitch (closed near -138). Right result, losing price - noted.

picks.name: Diamondbacks ML
picks.note: Beat the closing price by 3.1 points and won a slugfest. Best read of the day.

picks.name: Red Sox ML
picks.note: READ FAILURE. Assumed a bullpen game, Cantillo dealt a shutout, and the lefty split was never checked. This pick is now the standing reference case for what the gate must verify before a card ships.

days.brief: 2-1 with the loss named plainly: Boston was a process failure, not bad luck - an assumption shipped where a check belonged, and it cost 5u and the +339 parlay with it. The rule that came out of it: probable pitchers and splits get verified, never assumed. Arizona beat the close, the Yankees won at a worse-than-close price, and the day finished +0.80u.

days.label: Friday, Sep 25

picks.name: Orioles ML
picks.note: Never trailed. Scored first in the 3rd and stacked it to 10-2.

picks.name: Guardians ML
picks.note: Bullpen day for CLE after a 3.1-IP start; the bats answered every KC push, including five in the 9th.

picks.name: Astros ML
picks.note: Led 1-0 into the 6th, then ATH hung six. Rallied from 6-1 down to 6-5, but Smith K stranded the tying run on third in the 8th, and a 9th-inning walk died on a game-ending double play vs Harris (17th save). Beat the close, bad outcome.

days.brief: 2-1, -0.87u. Baltimore and Cleveland were clean reads that won; Houston was the right price at the wrong outcome - led 1-0, gave up six in the 6th, rallied from 6-1 down to 6-5, and the last two threats died on a strikeout with the tying run on third and a game-ending double play. The +437 parlay died with the Houston leg. Pricing discipline held: all three picks beat or matched the Kalshi close.

days.label: Saturday, Sep 26

picks.name: Toledo ML
picks.note: Wire-to-wire. Up 27-3 at the half, never threatened. +3.65u on 5u.

picks.name: Nebraska ML
picks.note: +4.44u on 10u at the -225 published card price. Closed Kalshi 99c - CLV +32pp. Genatone 1yd TD at 10:05 Q4 sealed it.

picks.name: Mississippi St ML
picks.note: +2.44u on 5u @-205, published-card basis. Closed Kalshi 99/100. Decider: 4th-down goal-line breakup at 1:20 Q4 (turnover on downs).

days.brief: The market's margin was the misprice, not the side. MSST was a thin-edge home favorite the model liked but couldn't card (1.2pp below bar) while books hung 66c against a Mizzou team traveling without its starting EDGE and lead RB - a 2.6c book-vs-exchange divergence confirmed the gap. It sweated (55/56 tied in Q4), then closed 99/100: +33pp CLV. New standing rule from this game: near-miss candidates like this get GEM-flagged on every card across all 13 leagues (near-bar edge, 55-75c zone, home side, opponent availability flags) instead of silently cut - and a gem earns its card spot by passing 2 more full checks, morning or intraday.
